name: Louis Pasteur
summary: Results-driven Network Administrator with over 5 years of experience in managing and optimizing networks for various organizations. Proven track record of enhancing network performance and security. Strong analytical skills and commitment to providing excellent IT support.

description: Managed day-to-day operations of local area and wide area networks.
Configured and maintained routers and switches.
Performed regular security audits to ensure data safety.
Provided technical support and guidance to staff on network issues.
Assisted in the configuration and installation of network hardware and software.
Monitored network performance and resolved issues.
Engaged in troubleshooting problems with network connectivity.
Maintained network user accounts and ensured security protocols.

extra_info.title: Projects
items: Implemented a company-wide VPN solution improving remote work capabilities.
Upgraded network infrastructure resulting in a 30% increase in speed and efficiency.
Developed a comprehensive network security policy that reduced vulnerabilities.
